1.1.3 Tenant Member: Any individual who is a bonafide tenant of a property within Green Meadows, holding a valid rental agreement of not less than eleven (11) months duration. Tenant Members may attend General Body Meetings but shall not be entitled to vote or contest elections.

1.1.4 Associate Member: Any immediate family member (spouse, children above 18 years) of a Resident Member or Non-Resident Owner Member, residing in the same household. Associate Members may attend meetings but shall not have voting rights.

1.2 Admission Procedure

1.2.1 Application for membership shall be made in the prescribed form, accompanied by proof of ownership (sale deed / registered conveyance deed / allotment letter) or tenancy (registered rental agreement), and the applicable admission fee as decided by the Management Committee from time to time.

1.2.2 The Management Committee shall consider the application at its next meeting and may approve or reject it. In case of rejection, the applicant shall be informed in writing of the reasons for rejection within fifteen (15) days.

1.2.3 No person shall be admitted as a member if they have been convicted of any offence involving moral turpitude or fraud, or if their admission is likely to be detrimental to the peace and harmony of the community.

1.3 Cessation of Membership

1.3.1 Membership shall cease upon:
a) Transfer of ownership of the property, unless the new owner applies for membership afresh;
b) Termination of tenancy;
c) Written resignation;
d) Expulsion by a resolution passed by two-thirds of the members present and voting at a General Body Meeting.

1.3.2 A member who has been expelled shall not be eligible for re-admission for a period of two (2) years from the date of expulsion.

1.3.3 Any member who fails to pay the annual subscription or any other dues (maintenance charges, special levies) for a continuous period of six (6) months shall be deemed to be a defaulter. A defaulter shall not be entitled to vote or contest elections, and may be liable for suspension of services (access to club house, swimming pool, etc.) as decided by the Management Committee.

CHAPTER II – MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE

2.1 Composition

The Management Committee shall consist of nine (9) members elected from amongst the Resident Members and Non-Resident Owner Members, as follows:

| Office | Number |
|--------|--------|
| President | 1 |
| Vice-President | 1 |
| Secretary | 1 |
| Joint Secretary | 1 |
| Treasurer | 1 |
| Members | 4 |
| **Total** | **9** |

2.2 Term of Office

2.2.1 The term of office of the Management Committee shall be two (2) years, commencing from the date of the Annual General Meeting at which they are elected.

2.2.2 No person shall hold the office of President for more than two (2) consecutive terms. Other office bearers may be re-elected without restriction, subject to the provisions of the Act.

2.3 Powers and Duties of the Management Committee

2.3.1 The Management Committee shall be responsible for the day-to-day administration of the Association, including but not limited to:
a) Maintenance of common areas, roads, parks, and infrastructure;
b) Collection of maintenance charges and other levies;
c) Engagement and supervision of service providers (security, housekeeping, gardening);
d) Management of the Association's finances and accounts;
e) Implementation of decisions taken at General Body Meetings;
f) Enforcement of these bye-laws and the establishment of standing rules for the use of common facilities.

2.3.2 The Management Committee may, by a simple majority, create sub-committees (e.g., Finance Sub-Committee, Grievance Sub-Committee, Cultural Sub-Committee) and delegate specific functions to them. The sub-committee shall report to the Management Committee.

2.3.3 The Management Committee shall meet at least once a month. The quorum for a Management Committee meeting shall be five (5) members. In case of a vacancy, the quorum shall be reduced to the next whole number above half of the remaining members.
3.1.5 No member of a Standing Committee shall be entitled to any remuneration for services rendered, but may be reimbursed for actual and reasonable expenses incurred in the discharge of their duties, with prior approval of the Management Committee.

3.1.6 All Standing Committees shall function in accordance with the provisions of these bye-laws and the directions of the Management Committee. In case of any conflict between the decisions of a Standing Committee and the bye-laws, the bye-laws shall prevail.

3.1.7 A Standing Committee may, with the prior approval of the Management Committee, invite experts or specialists to its meetings for advice on specific matters. Such invitees shall not have the right to vote.

3.2 Maintenance Committee

3.2.1 Constitution

The Maintenance Committee shall consist of the following members:

| S. No. | Designation | Number |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| 1 | Chairman (from Management Committee) | 1 |
| 2 | Secretary (from Management Committee) | 1 |
| 3 | Members co-opted from residents | 3 |
| 4 | Member from Non-Resident Owner category | 1 |
| **Total** | | **6** |

3.2.2 The Maintenance Committee shall be responsible for:

a) Day-to-day upkeep and repair of common areas, including roads, footpaths, parks, children's play areas, and boundary walls;

b) Supervision of housekeeping and gardening staff and service contractors;

c) Inspection of the premises for safety hazards and rectification thereof;

d) Arranging for painting, whitewashing, and major repairs of common facilities as approved by the Management Committee;

e) Operation and maintenance of lifts, water pumps, generators, and other common equipment;

f) Monitoring of water supply, sewage, and drainage systems; and

g) Any other maintenance-related duties assigned by the Management Committee.

3.2.3 Meetings and Frequency

The Maintenance Committee shall meet at least once a month. The standing rules indicate that the Maintenance Committee meeting frequency is monthly. Record status: current. This is the current rule and shall remain in force unless amended by the Management Committee in accordance with Clause 10.2.

3.2.4 The quorum for a Maintenance Committee meeting shall be four (4) members. In the absence of the Chairman, the members present shall elect one of their number to preside over the meeting.

3.2.5 The Secretary of the Maintenance Committee shall record the minutes of each meeting and circulate them to the Management Committee within seven (7) days of the meeting.

3.2.6 Special meetings of the Maintenance Committee may be convened by the Chairman or by the Secretary upon the written request of at least two (2) members of the committee.

3.2.7 The Maintenance Committee shall maintain a register of all maintenance works carried out, expenses incurred, and receipts obtained. The register shall be open for inspection by members of the Association during the office hours of the Management Committee.

3.3 Finance Sub-Committee

3.3.1 Constitution

The Finance Sub-Committee shall consist of the following members:

| S. No. | Designation | Number |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| 1 | Chairman (Treasurer of the Management Committee) | 1 |
| 2 | Member from Management Committee | 1 |
| 3 | Members co-opted from residents having accounting/finance background | 2 |
| **Total** | | **4** |

3.3.2 The Finance Sub-Committee shall be responsible for:

a) Preparation of the annual budget of the Association and its presentation to the Management Committee;

b) Review of income and expenditure on a quarterly basis and reporting the same to the Management Committee;

c) Scrutiny of all bills and invoices before payment;

d) Ensuring timely collection of maintenance charges and other levies;

e) Recommendation of investment avenues for surplus funds, subject to the approval of the Management Committee;

f) Liaison with the statutory auditor for the annual audit of accounts; and

g) Any other financial matters assigned by the Management Committee.
4. USE OF COMMUNITY HALL AND OTHER COMMON FACILITIES

4.1 General

4.1.1 The Community Hall, hereinafter referred to as "the Hall", shall be available for use by all members of the Association for social, cultural, educational, and recreational purposes, subject to the provisions of these Bye-laws and the rules framed thereunder.

4.1.2 The Hall shall not be used for any activity which is illegal, immoral, or which may cause nuisance or disturbance to other residents of Green Meadows. The Management Committee reserves the right to refuse permission for any event which, in its opinion, is not in the interest of the community.

4.1.3 No activity shall be undertaken in the Hall which may cause damage to the building, furniture, fixtures, or equipment. The member to whom the Hall is allotted shall be responsible for any damage caused during the period of use.

4.1.4 The Hall shall be used only for the purpose for which it is allotted. Any change in the purpose of the event shall require fresh permission from the Management Committee.

4.2 Booking Procedure

4.2.1 Members desirous of booking the Hall shall apply in writing to the Secretary of the Association on the prescribed booking form, which shall be available with the Secretary or the caretaker of the Hall.

4.2.2 The application shall contain the following particulars:

a) Name and flat number of the member;

b) Date and time for which the Hall is required;

c) Nature of the event;

d) Approximate number of guests expected;

e) Name and contact number of the person who shall be responsible for the event; and

f) Any special requirements, such as additional furniture, sound system, or catering arrangements.

4.2.3 Applications for booking shall be made at least seven (7) days in advance of the proposed date of the event. However, the Management Committee may, at its discretion, consider applications made with shorter notice, subject to the availability of the Hall.

4.2.4 Bookings shall be confirmed by the Secretary, or by any other office bearer authorised by the Management Committee, upon payment of the booking charges as prescribed from time to time. The booking charges shall be notified by the Management Committee and displayed on the notice board of the Association.

4.2.5 The Hall shall be allotted on a first-come-first-served basis, provided that the Management Committee may give priority to events organised by the Association itself or by any of its committees.

4.2.6 No booking shall be considered final unless the booking charges have been paid in full and a written confirmation has been issued by the Secretary.

4.2.7 In the event of cancellation of a booking by a member, the booking charges shall be refunded as follows:

a) If the cancellation is made more than fifteen (15) days before the date of the event, the full amount shall be refunded;

b) If the cancellation is made between seven (7) and fifteen (15) days before the date of the event, fifty percent (50%) of the booking charges shall be refunded; and

c) If the cancellation is made less than seven (7) days before the date of the event, no refund shall be made.

4.2.8 The Management Committee may cancel a booking at any time if the Hall is required for any urgent work of the Association or for any emergency. In such a case, the booking charges shall be refunded in full, and the Association shall not be liable for any other expenses incurred by the member.

4.3 Conditions of Use

4.3.1 The member to whom the Hall is allotted shall be present during the entire period of the event and shall ensure that the conditions of use are observed by all guests.

4.3.2 The Hall shall be vacated by the time specified in the booking confirmation. Any extension of time shall be granted only with the prior permission of the Secretary or the caretaker, and additional charges may apply.

4.3.3 The member shall ensure that the Hall is left clean and tidy after the event. The cost of any special cleaning required shall be borne by the member.

1.3 Cessation of Membership

1.3.1 Membership shall cease upon:

b) Termination of tenancy;

CHAPTER II – MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE

2.2.1 The term of office of the Management Committee shall be two (2) years, commencing from the date of the Annual General Meeting at which they are elected.

2.2.2 No person shall hold the office of President for more than two (2) consecutive terms. Other office bearers may be re-elected without restriction, subject to the provisions of the Act.

2.3 Powers and Duties of the Management Committee

2.3.1 The Management Committee shall be responsible for the day-to-day administration of the Association, including but not limited to:
a) Maintenance of common areas, roads, parks, and infrastructure;
b) Collection of maintenance charges and other levies;
c) Engagement and supervision of service providers (security, housekeeping, gardening);
d) Management of the Association's finances and accounts;
e) Implementation of decisions taken at General Body Meetings;
f) Enforcement of these bye-laws and the establishment of standing rules for the use of common facilities.

2.3.2 The Management Committee may, by a simple majority, create sub-committees (e.g., Finance Sub-Committee, Grievance Sub-Committee, Cultural Sub-Committee) and delegate specific functions to them. The sub-committee shall report to the Management Committee.

2.3.3 The Management Committee shall meet at least once a month. The quorum for a Management Committee meeting shall be five (5) members. In case of a vacancy, the quorum shall be reduced to the next whole number above half of the remaining members.

4. USE OF COMMUNITY HALL AND OTHER COMMON FACILITIES

4.1 General

4.1.1 The Community Hall, hereinafter referred to as "the Hall", shall be available for use by all members of the Association for social, cultural, educational, and recreational purposes, subject to the provisions of these Bye-laws and the rules framed thereunder.

4.1.2 The Hall shall not be used for any activity which is illegal, immoral, or which may cause nuisance or disturbance to other residents of Green Meadows. The Management Committee reserves the right to refuse permission for any event which, in its opinion, is not in the interest of the community.

4.1.3 No activity shall be undertaken in the Hall which may cause damage to the building, furniture, fixtures, or equipment. The member to whom the Hall is allotted shall be responsible for any damage caused during the period of use.

4.1.4 The Hall shall be used only for the purpose for which it is allotted. Any change in the purpose of the event shall require fresh permission from the Management Committee.

4.2 Booking Procedure

4.2.1 Members desirous of booking the Hall shall apply in writing to the Secretary of the Association on the prescribed booking form, which shall be available with the Secretary or the caretaker of the Hall.

4.2.2 The application shall contain the following particulars:

a) Name and flat number of the member;

b) Date and time for which the Hall is required;

c) Nature of the event;

d) Approximate number of guests expected;

e) Name and contact number of the person who shall be responsible for the event; and

f) Any special requirements, such as additional furniture, sound system, or catering arrangements.

4.2.3 Applications for booking shall be made at least seven (7) days in advance of the proposed date of the event. However, the Management Committee may, at its discretion, consider applications made with shorter notice, subject to the availability of the Hall.

4.2.4 Bookings shall be confirmed by the Secretary, or by any other office bearer authorised by the Management Committee, upon payment of the booking charges as prescribed from time to time. The booking charges shall be notified by the Management Committee and displayed on the notice board of the Association.

4.2.5 The Hall shall be allotted on a first-come-first-served basis, provided that the Management Committee may give priority to events organised by the Association itself or by any of its committees.

4.2.6 No booking shall be considered final unless the booking charges have been paid in full and a written confirmation has been issued by the Secretary.

4.2.7 In the event of cancellation of a booking by a member, the booking charges shall be refunded as follows:

a) If the cancellation is made more than fifteen (15) days before the date of the event, the full amount shall be refunded;

b) If the cancellation is made between seven (7) and fifteen (15) days before the date of the event, fifty percent (50%) of the booking charges shall be refunded; and

c) If the cancellation is made less than seven (7) days before the date of the event, no refund shall be made.

4.2.8 The Management Committee may cancel a booking at any time if the Hall is required for any urgent work of the Association or for any emergency. In such a case, the booking charges shall be refunded in full, and the Association shall not be liable for any other expenses incurred by the member.

4.3 Conditions of Use

4.3.1 The member to whom the Hall is allotted shall be present during the entire period of the event and shall ensure that the conditions of use are observed by all guests.

4.3.2 The Hall shall be vacated by the time specified in the booking confirmation. Any extension of time shall be granted only with the prior permission of the Secretary or the caretaker, and additional charges may apply.

4.3.3 The member shall ensure that the Hall is left clean and tidy after the event. The cost of any special cleaning required shall be borne by the member.
